queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Wacom Tablet' AND publisher = 'Wacom Technology Corp.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Wacom Tablet' AND publisher = 'Wacom Technology Corp.' AND version_compare(version, '6.4.15-1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('wacomdesktopcenter.exe','wacom_tablet.exe'));
